control_link_connected.description: false: the Liquidsoap control link is down, so the item on air is unknown; the list then has no now row although something may play.

rows.description: In air order: played rows oldest first, at most one now row, then queued rows in planned order. At most air.played_count + 1 + air.queued_count rows.

end_utc.description: Aired and truncated: start plus the length that aired. Now: start plus the out point. Missed and queued: the planned end. Null only when the length is unknown (an emergency track without a duration).

in_liquidsoap.description: true for the now row and for queued rows already pushed to Liquidsoap; false for planned rows and played rows.

item_id.description: The play log row (played) or the plan item (now, queued); null for a now row without a plan item, such as an emergency track.

outage_id.description: Missed rows: the outage that kept the item off the air; null otherwise.

source.description: plan: an item of the track plan; emergency: a track of the emergency playlist.

start_utc.description: When it started (aired, truncated, now) or was planned to start (missed, queued).

status.description: played rows: aired, truncated, or missed (shown as "Not aired"); now: on air; queued rows: queued (already pushed to Liquidsoap) or planned.

force.description: Decode files that have not changed since their last analysis. Without it, their issues are only checked again against the current settings.

track_ids.description: Tracks to analyse; absent or empty: every track never analysed.

since.description: When the state last changed (UTC); kept across restarts of the backend. Null while unknown.

state.description: connected: Liquidsoap streams to Icecast and no outage is open; reconnecting: Liquidsoap lost its Icecast output and no outage is open yet; unreachable: a broadcast outage is open; unknown: no evidence yet after a start of the backend, or no heartbeat from Liquidsoap.

last_check_at.description: When the mount was last checked; null before the first check.

reason.description: The open outage's reason or component (unreachable only).

since.description: When the state last changed (UTC); kept across restarts of the backend. Null while unknown.

state.description: connected: Liquidsoap streams to Icecast and no outage is open; reconnecting: Liquidsoap lost its Icecast output and no outage is open yet; unreachable: a broadcast outage is open; unknown: no evidence yet after a start of the backend, or no heartbeat from Liquidsoap.

item_id.description: Plan item; absent for an emergency track.

item_id.description: Plan item; absent for an emergency track.

out_ms.description: Out point in the file: planned (plan items), or the cue out or the duration (emergency tracks), in ms.

finished_at.description: Set when the operation is no longer running.

operation_id.description: Its outcome arrives as <kind>.completed or <kind>.failed, and through GET /api/operations/{id}.

reason.description: Stable reason of a refused one-time insert (hour_insert, reschedule): it does not fit its window or the hour, or the track breaks a play rule at its start.

reconciled_at.description: When its missed items were marked.

weekdays.description: 1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday; leave out for every day.

clock_rule.description: Placement rule of the playlist in clocks; a clock may override it.

clock_count.description: Required for spread, not allowed otherwise.

clock_rule.description: Placement rule in clocks: fill the time left, spread clock_count tracks over the hour, the first track, the last track, both, or a track at about 30:00.

play_rule_ids.description: Play rules applied to every track of the playlist, in ID order.

code.description: Unique slug; never changes after creation.

is_system.description: True for music, jingle, news, and segment: renamable, never deletable.

connected.description: output: the Icecast output is connected.

elapsed_ms.description: end: how long the track played.

replace.description: Text that replaces every occurrence; empty or absent removes it.

changed.description: Tracks whose title changes (dry run) or changed.

unchanged.description: Tracks whose title has no occurrence of find, or stays the same.

offset_ms.description: Target start of placement fixed, whole seconds; required for it.

target_hour_start_utc.description: Start of a future station hour within the track plan.

not_found.description: Tracks that do not exist, in request order.

updated.description: Tracks marked or cleared, in request order.

name.description: Environment variable that holds the secret.

default.description: Value used until one is saved.

group.description: Settings page the key belongs to.

quality_ok.description: Absent until the file is analysed.

source_bitrate.description: Bits per second of the lossy file this one was transcoded from; it keeps the low_bitrate issue.

done.description: Tracks the operation has processed so far, this one included, whatever their outcome. Rises by one with each event of the operation.

operation_id.description: The import or analyse operation that processed the track.

outcome.description: What happened to the track: analysed (decoded and stored), rechecked (unchanged file, issues checked again), file missing, unreadable (not readable as audio, or its loudness not measurable), failed (a step failed; see the log), track deleted (removed while the operation ran). quality_issues.description: Codes of the problems found; empty when there are none, and always empty unless the outcome is analysed or rechecked.

fade_in_ms.description: Fade in at cue in; 0 is a hard cut. The panel proposes liquidsoap.cue_fade_in_ms.

fade_out_ms.description: Fade out ending at cue out; 0 is a hard cut. The fades together must not be longer than the on-air part. The panel proposes liquidsoap.cue_fade_out_ms.

build_operation_id.description: The clock_build operation that rebuilds the future hours holding a planned item of the track, so they use the new cut. Absent when only fades changed or the track is not planned.

item_id.description: Plan item; absent for an emergency track.

status.description: The play log status: truncated when it played less than planned (cut by the plan, the hour switch, or a skip).

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor to read the next page; set only in the default order (title, asc), absent on the last page.

total.description: Tracks matching the filters, on every page.

inserts.description: One-time inserts of the hour, in ID order; they stay when the hour is rebuilt.

seed.description: Seed of the build; the same input and seed give the same plan.

missed_id.description: The missed item it airs again (a reschedule).

offset_ms.description: Target start of a fixed insert, whole seconds.

hour_insert_id.description: The one-time insert of an hour_insert or reschedule item.

insert_id.description: The template insert of an insert item; absent when the insert was removed since.

planned_in_ms.description: In point from the start of the file (the track's cue in when it was planned).

planned_out_ms.description: Out point from the start of the file; the length is planned_out_ms - planned_in_ms, shorter than the track's air_duration_ms when truncated.

truncated.description: The track crosses the next insert or the end of the hour; it fades out and ends there.

from.description: Hours that start at or after this instant.

to.description: ... and before this one; at most 7 days after from. Hours that have started are never rebuilt.

hour_insert_id.description: The one-time insert the warning is about.

code.description: Why the track was kept; the codes of DELETE /api/tracks/{id}.

title.description: Title of the track; absent for track_not_found.

used_by.description: Clocks with an insert of the track and its one-time inserts (track_in_use).

max_peak.description: The largest absolute value in peaks, so the drawing can be scaled to it (0 for silence). In dBFS: 20 × log10(max_peak / 127).

peaks.description: The min and max amplitude of every bucket of a mono mix, -127 to 127 (linear; 127 is full scale, 0 dBFS), flat: [min0, max0, min1, max1, ...]. The last bucket may be partial.

fix.description: loudness: bring the loudness to stream.loudness_target_lufs, keeping the format. optimize: convert to the broadcast standard (settings import.target_*) and fix the loudness.

output.description: replace: the new file replaces the original. copy: the new file is written as <name>.optimal.<ext> next to the original, which stays on disk; the track then plays the copy.

quality_ok.description: Manual override of the quality check.

info.description: REST API of the Radio Atlantida backend. No authentication: the API is reachable only from localhost or a private network. All times are ISO 8601 UTC. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with stable codes. UI events are sent over the WebSocket at GET /api/ws; their payloads are the schemas Event, ErrorAlertEvent, and Operation*Event.
info.title: Radio Atlantida API

Starts an import operation: every audio file of the folder and its subfolders that is not a track yet becomes one where it lies, with the given type, playlists, and artist; nothing is moved, and tracks that exist already are not changed. The title comes from the title tag, else from the file name; the artist from artist_id, else the artist tag, else the file name ("Artist - Title" with exactly one hyphen). A file with the content of an existing track (a copy) or not readable as audio is left alone. Refused with media_operation_running while another import, analysis, or transcode runs, and with media_tools_unavailable when ffmpeg is missing.

post.description: Registers a file by its path under the media root; the file may arrive later. When it exists, metadata left out is read from it with ffprobe. A path used by another track is a field error (taken).

Starts an analysis operation: reads format, bitrate, sample rate, channels, duration, and loudness of the files and checks them against the broadcast standard (quality_issues). A missing file gets file_missing. Refused with media_operation_running while another import, analysis, or transcode runs, and with media_tools_unavailable when ffmpeg is missing.

Deletes several tracks from the library (the files are not touched), each like DELETE /api/tracks/{id}. Refused tracks are listed in refused with the reason; the others are deleted. Runs to the end even when the client disconnects.

Replaces every occurrence of find in the titles of the tracks (literal text; case ignored unless match_case), then trims the title and collapses runs of white space. With dry_run true it returns the preview and writes nothing; with false it writes the changed titles in one transaction, computed again from the stored titles, and clears their reviewed mark. A title that would become empty or longer than 500 characters is refused, not cut.
Sets or clears the reviewed mark of several tracks in one statement. A track already reviewed keeps the time of its first mark. Tracks that do not exist are listed in not_found.

Starts a transcode operation (Fix loudness, Optimize track). A track is skipped when the fix removes none of its issues, while it is queued, on air, or planned to start within playout.prepush_minutes + 5 minutes, and when the target path belongs to another track. Refused with media_operation_running while another import, analysis, or transcode runs, and with media_tools_unavailable when ffmpeg is missing.

delete.description: Removes the track from the library (the file is not touched). Refused while a clock insert or a one-time insert of the plan uses it (track_in_use, with used_by), and for a track with play history or in the track plan (track_has_history).

put.description: Replaces the metadata and the playlists of a track. Optional fields left out are cleared, then metadata is read from the file where it exists. The title is trimmed and runs of white space become one space; control characters (line breaks, tabs) are refused (invalid_characters). A new title or artist clears the reviewed mark; playlists, type, notes, and the quality override do not. The file path and the length cannot be sent here (unknown_field): the file changes only by replace-file. The title and artist go on air with requests pushed to Liquidsoap after the save; items already queued keep the old ones.

get.description: Streams the file of the track for the preview player in the panel (§6.6). Supports Range requests, so seeking works. The preview plays in the browser only: it never reaches the air or the play log. A missing file is track_file_not_found.

200.description: The audio file, or the requested range of it.

416.description: The requested range is outside the file.

put.description: Sets the part of the file that goes on air (cue_in_ms to cue_out_ms) and the fades at those points; the file is not changed. A cut must leave at least 5 s on air (air_too_short), and the fades together must fit in it (fades_too_long). Refused for a track without a duration (track_not_analysed) and while a plan item of the track is queued in Liquidsoap or it is on air (track_on_air). When cue in or out changed, the future hours that hold a planned item of the track are rebuilt (build_operation_id); items already queued keep their cut. Fades only need no rebuild: they are read when a request is pushed. The reviewed mark is kept.
put.summary: Set the cue points of a track

put.description: Rules of the track itself. The rules of its playlists apply too; all of them must pass.
put.summary: Set the play rules of a track

post.description: Points the track at another file under the media root and analyses it (checksum, format, loudness, quality issues) in one step; the response is the updated track. The old file is not removed. The reviewed mark is cleared unless the path and the content are both unchanged, and the cue is reset when it no longer fits the new length. The same path with the same content changes nothing, the reviewed mark stays. Refused while a clock insert, a one-time insert, or a plan item that has not aired uses the track (track_in_use, with used_by), while the track is queued in Liquidsoap or on air (track_in_use), and while another media operation runs (media_operation_running). A path that another track has is a field error (taken); a missing file is track_file_not_found.
post.summary: Replace the file of a track

get.description: The min and max amplitude of every 50 ms of the track file, for the cue editor. Computed with ffmpeg on the first request and stored until the file changes (its checksum); the ETag is the checksum, so a client sends If-None-Match and gets 304 while it is current. A missing or unreadable file is waveform_unavailable; without ffmpeg, media_tools_unavailable.

parameters.description: The ETag of a waveform the client holds; 304 while it is current.
parameters.name: If-None-Match

schema.description: The ETag of a waveform the client holds; 304 while it is current.
The checksum of the file the waveform was computed for; absent for a track never analysed.

304.description: The waveform of If-None-Match is current.

get.summary: Get the waveform of a track

get.description: Upgrades to a WebSocket. The server sends one JSON text message per event (schema Event); the panel sends nothing. A client that falls behind is disconnected and should reconnect and catch up through GET /api/operations.

101.description: Switching Protocols: the connection is a WebSocket. Each message is one Event.

403.description: Cross-origin request from an origin that is not allowed.
